trust_decision.summary: Open redirect: a user-supplied `redirectTo` value is used as a navigation target with no same-origin check at three UI points (OIDC callback, token-renew, login page); the fix adds `isSafeRedirectPath` to ui/src/config/auth.ts and gates all three consumers. The value also crosses a full-page IdP round trip through sessionStorage `platform_redirect`, so the guard must hold on the rehydrated string and not only on the query parameter.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names the OIDC login flow's `redirectTo` query parameter; this is the block that reads `redirectTo` out of the stored query string and calls `window.location.replace(window.location.origin + redirectTo)` without validating the value.

fix_sites.entry_point: shared helper imported by the /login page, the /token-renew page and the OIDC callback component
fix_sites.module_kind: shared config/helper module (new file content in an existing config module)

fix_sites.entry_point: OIDC callback: any UI route re-entered with ?code=&state= after the IdP round trip (login button at ui/src/features/auth/oidc-login.tsx:79-101)
/token-renew?redirectTo=... (silent token refresh route, paths.tokenRenew at ui/src/config/paths.ts:24)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The redirect target reached through the OIDC path does not come from the request URL at all: it is re-read from sessionStorage key `platform_redirect`, which Kargo's own login handler wrote (ui/src/features/auth/oidc-login.tsx:88), so a solver can argue it is trusted internal state and that guarding the `redirectTo` query parameter at the login page is sufficient.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate deep links must keep redirecting after login, including same-origin paths that carry a query string or fragment (the analysis-run logs page reads ?job=&container=&search= and the freight timeline reads ?view=&timerange=&showColors=&images=). An over-broad fix that rejects any redirectTo containing '?', '#' or ':' , or that whitelists only the static entries of `paths`, breaks those links; likewise a fix that always redirects to paths.home breaks the whole return-to-page feature.

O6_input_shapes: absent or empty redirectTo -> fall back to paths.home (ui/src/features/auth/token-renew.tsx:96, ui/src/pages/login/login.tsx:29)
same-origin relative path starting with '/' , optionally with a query string or fragment -> allowed (fix.diff:15-18)
absolute URL such as https://evil.example -> rejected because it does not start with '/' (fix.diff:16)
protocol-relative //evil.example and backslash form /\evil.example -> rejected by the URL-origin comparison (fix.diff:18)
the same value re-read as a plain string from sessionStorage `platform_redirect`, i.e. not a URL object and not the current query parameter (ui/src/features/auth/oidc-login.tsx:152-154)

O7_producer.where: ui/src/features/auth/oidc-login.tsx:88 (sessionStorage.setItem of window.location.search under `platform_redirect`), re-read at ui/src/features/auth/oidc-login.tsx:108

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third transport or interceptor whose logout/renewToken redirects to /login or /token-renew carrying a caller-supplied return path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: transport.ts:10-16 and ui/src/lib/api/custom-fetch.ts:23-33 already hold near-identical logout/renewToken pairs that build `${paths.login}?redirectTo=${window.location.pathname}`; copying that pair into a new transport or orval mutator is this repo's established pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second login-redirect producer with an alias parameter (e.g. ?next= or ?returnTo=) instead of redirectTo
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: four independent places already construct `${paths.login}?${redirectToQueryParam}=...` (ui/src/pages/user.tsx:21, ui/src/features/auth/protected-route.tsx:27, ui/src/config/transport.ts:10, ui/src/lib/api/custom-fetch.ts:26); adding an alias for backwards compatibility would look perfectly natural.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second persisted redirect slot (another sessionStorage/localStorage key, or a stored full URL rather than a path) consumed after the IdP callback
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the OIDC component already persists three keys (PKCE_code_verifier, PKCE_state, platform_redirect) and never clears them, so one more slot holding the post-login destination is an obvious maintainer change.

O9_family: open_redirect (CWE-601, URL redirection to untrusted site)

O10_build.language: TypeScript / React (the fix diff touches no Go)
O10_build.toolchain: Node + pnpm 9.0.3; vite 7.1.5 for the build; tsc --noEmit for typecheck; vitest 4.0.16 for tests (ui/package.json:5-14)
O10_build.project_tests: vitest is wired up (ui/package.json:14) but there is no test for the auth area at the pinned commit: the only tests are ui/src/utils/*.test.ts, ui/src/features/common/analysis-modal/transforms.test.ts, ui/src/features/freight-timeline/open-container-initiative-utils.test.ts, ui/src/features/stage/utils/promotion.test.ts, ui/src/pages/downloads/releases.test.ts and ui/tests/api/apimachinery.spec.ts; the fix diff adds no tests.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add `if (/^https?:/.test(redirectTo)) return;` (or a bare `startsWith('/')`) only in the OIDC callback and stop there.

out_of_scope_notes: pkg/cli/cmd/login/login.go:413-470 runs a localhost OAuth callback for the kargo CLI; it validates `state` and takes no user-supplied redirect target, so it is a separate auth flow and was not pursued.
The five listed fix commits are byte-identical fork merge commits carrying the same four-file change (see fix.diff:5-514).
unverified: repo_mb could not be measured (no shell in this session); ui/src/gen holds large generated protobuf, so the tree is well above 5 MB but its size in MB is unknown.
`many_fix_commits` is recorded per its mechanical definition (5 > 4 commits) even though the five commits carry identical content and the change is not actually split.

Whether `<Navigate to={generatePath(redirectTo)}>` at ui/src/pages/login/login.tsx:29 really performs a cross-origin navigation under react-router-dom 7.9.6 was not runtime-verified; the published fix treats that site as a sink, so it is counted.
The full OIDC round trip needs an external IdP; the guard itself is pure client-side and testable offline, but it was only read, never executed.

ui/src/features/auth/token-renew.tsx:90,100,110 still interpolate the unvalidated `redirectQuery` into `/login?redirectTo=...` after the fix; considered and excluded as an O8 route because the target is always the same-origin /login path and the value is re-validated by the login page.
